pull_quote.text: Computer use is a particularly important part of what's new. I think that it has crossed the qualitative threshold. So Astra can really do anything a human can do with a computer without an API.

stories.headline: How Language Models Weigh Outside Evidence, and When They Ignore It
stories.key_takeaway: MIT researchers found that twelve LLMs are not Bayesian evidence integrators: they underweight their own priors, defer to text merely claiming to come from a tool, and adopt constraint-violating answers 93 to 100 percent of the time even after internally verifying they are invalid.

pull_quote.text: A model may state a rule, identify a contradiction, critique a candidate, or give a correct explanation without allowing that information to govern its action.

data_points.label: Weight models give their own prior; rational is 1.0

stories.article_excerpt: Ask a model to solve a problem, then hand it an answer from a tool. What it does next is not what you would expect.
